head: b2c8ac5bc1add70ba8f7fbbcc2924c03a9b05e99
notes: Fresh nvim process and empty XDG tree on every run; OS page cache was not flushed.
Order AB,BA,AB. Both servers use push diagnostics and the same lazydev local-workspace adapter.
Undefined-global probe is inserted only into memory before return M. Real quality counts exclude that line.
Diagnostics settled = no active progress plus 2s of diagnostic/progress silence, minus the 2s observation window.
RSS sampled from /proc every 10ms; tree includes nvim and descendants; server RSS includes all descendants and may double-count shared pages.
Performance data uses final Git flake dev output. Separate quality runs do not contribute to performance/peak metrics.
